Modules¶

Database models for the News API application. Includes CustomeUser with RBAC, Publisher, Article with approval signals, and Newsletter models.

news.models.article_approval_handler(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]¶

Triggers email notifications and webhook POST requests when an article is approved.

news.models.sync_user_groups(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]¶

Automatically assigns users to Django Groups matching their role.

Front-end web views for authentication, dashboards, and role-based workflows.

news.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Approves an article from the editor dashboard.

news.views.article_feed(request)[source]¶

Displays public approved articles and newsletters.

news.views.create_article(request)[source]¶

Allows journalists to create a new article for review.

news.views.create_newsletter(request)[source]¶

Allows editors and journalists to create a new compiled newsletter.

news.views.dashboard_redirect(request)[source]¶

Routes users to their role-specific dashboard.

news.views.delete_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows editors or the article’s journalist author to delete an article.

news.views.delete_newsletter(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows editors or authors to delete a newsletter.

news.views.edit_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows editors or the article’s journalist author to update the article.

news.views.edit_newsletter(request, pk)[source]¶

Allows editors or the newsletter author to edit an existing newsletter.

news.views.editor_dashbaord(request)[source]¶

Displays pending articles and newsletters for editor review and management.

news.views.journalist_dashboard(request)[source]¶

Displays articles authored by the logged-in journalist.

news.views.login_view(request)[source]¶

Handles user login.

news.views.manage_publishers(request)[source]¶

Allows creation and management of publishers (Restricted to Editors).

news.views.manage_subscriptions(request)[source]¶

Allows readers to toggle publisher and journalist subscriptions.

news.views.reader_dashboard(request)[source]¶

Personalized landing page for readers showing articles and newsletters from their subscriptions.

news.views.register_view(request)[source]¶

Handles new user registration.
